Who we are

More than a website. A digital home for systems change.

Bringing Up California brings together families, early childhood providers, advocates, researchers, and policymakers from across sectors and communities. Our work starts from a simple belief: the systems around young children should be built with the people closest to them.

This redesigned home connects people to policy, makes knowledge easier to find and use, elevates community wisdom, and strengthens the partnerships that move shared priorities into collective action.

🌿Racial equity, in practice

Every priority is tested against one question: does it close gaps for the children furthest from opportunity?

☀️Assets, not deficits

Families and cultures are presented as strengths — in our language, imagery, and policy design.

🧭Community wisdom

Lived experience sits alongside research and data in every brief, story, and recommendation.

🤝Shared power

A multisector coalition where members set the agenda together — and share the wins.

Appendix · Not part of the homepage

Design notes for the review panel

This is the light version of the concept. It shows the direction proposed in our RFP response: a standalone digital home for the coalition, replacing the single long page the coalition has today — presented on white, in Bringing Up California’s official colours, with no dark header, hero, or panels. Toggle “Show design notes on the page” at the top to see each choice marked in place. Photography throughout is the coalition's own — the February Retreat of February 19–20, 2025 and the 2025 Inaugural Summit in Oakland — and sample listings show layout and content types.

Audience-first structure

Policymakers, advocates and partners, and families each get a named front door in the first screen — the journey mapping set out in the proposal, made visible.

Finder, not a PDF library

The Policy & Resource Finder above is fully working in this mockup: search and audience filters demonstrate the findability standard the live build will meet.

Accessible & multilingual

Built to WCAG 2.1 AA: strong contrast, visible focus, keyboard-friendly controls, and plain language. The EN / ES toggle previews the bilingual experience.

Staff-friendly editing

News, events, stories, and priorities are structured blocks coalition staff can update in minutes on WordPress — no developer needed for day-to-day publishing.

The coalition's own brand — light version

This light version presents the official Bringing Up California logo and colours on white throughout: teal #00A0A0 as the main colour for headings, links, buttons, and accents, with coral red #F04050, golden yellow #FFC010, and leaf green #90C050 as secondary accents only — white header, white hero, and pale teal or pale grey cards in every section, with the coalition's own photography.

Built to grow

The members area, action alerts, and convening listings shown here are homepage surfaces for the member portal and campaign tools in the full proposal scope.
